b'# tinydl

A tiny command-line downloader. It fetches a URL and writes the bytes to a
file (or to stdout). See `notes.md` and `todo.txt` for project planning.

## Usage

```
python -m app.cli [options] url
```

## Command line options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `url` | what to download |
| `-o`, `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no progress output |

## Example

Download a file to `out.bin`:

```
python -m app.cli https://example.com/file.bin -o out.bin
```
'
